# A Workshopper's Guide to the Vector

Source: [1903](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/1903); edited 2023-06-11. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

<a id="wiki-1903-n1"></a>

- Documented Workshop axes: Y is height, X/Z horizontal; local player space uses positive X left, positive Y up, positive Z forward, and foot position as the origin.

<a id="wiki-1903-n2"></a>

- Position Of returns world position; Local Vector Of transforms world positions into player-relative coordinates. Position transforms need Rotation and Translation; pure directions should not be treated as locations.

<a id="wiki-1903-n3"></a>

- Live Capture (Camera) records eye position, approximately 1.5 m above the player's feet, rather than foot position.

<a id="wiki-1903-n4"></a>

- B minus A gives displacement from A to B; Normalize obtains unit direction and Magnitude Of(velocity) gives speed.

<a id="wiki-1903-n5"></a>

- Facing Direction's Y varies from -1 looking down to +1 looking up; normalized facing components are world-space.

Source limitations:

- June 2023 archive, not independently tested.

- Text overgeneralizes that direction vectors are always unit length and all global vectors are position vectors; later displacement discussion contradicts the first claim.

- Text calls vector-scalar addition undefined mathematically; Workshop runtime coercion must be checked in API references instead of inheriting this as an engine guarantee.

- Pitch treatment for Local Vector Of is not fully specified in this tutorial; it describes horizontal facing.
